color-no-hex.message: Use a design-system token (var(--pw-*)) or color-mix(in srgb, var(--pw-*) N%, transparent) instead of a hex literal. If this color must be hardcoded (brand identity, scrim, contrast-pair, typed icon), add /* stylelint-disable-next-line color-no-hex -- justification */.

function-disallowed-list.message: Use a design-system token (var(--pw-*)) or color-mix(in srgb, var(--pw-*) N%, transparent) instead of raw rgb/rgba/hsl. If this color must be hardcoded (scrim, animation keyframe, typed icon), add /* stylelint-disable-next-line function-disallowed-list -- justification */.
